caption: The drawing features three small, oval-shaped objects depicted in gray tones, evenly spaced against a plain light beige background. Each object is shown from a different view: the topmost object displays a decorative, cursive "H" engraved on its surface; the object to the left is presented in a flat, face-on view with a vertical slit or post in the center; and the object to the right is drawn from the side, showing a thin, flat oval with a small loop or latch attached. In the lower left corner of the drawing, the name "JOHN. H. TERCUZZI." is written in small, block letters.
